snippet.title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails to Azure - Announcement Trailer (Nintendo Switch 2, PS5)
snippet.description:
Welcome back to Crossbell! The Legend of Heroes: Trails to Azure is coming to the Nintendo Switch 2 and PlayStation 5 with improved performance, higher resolution, and upscaled textures to create the most visually striking version of this legendary title to date!

In this direct sequel to Trails from Zero, the Special Support Section find themselves with new members and new duties. However, rising tensions in Crossbell and threats from abroad could unravel everything they know about their home.

Experience the definitive version of The Legend of Heroes: Trails to Azure later this year!

Follow @NISAmerica on X, Instagram, and Facebook for updates! 
Learn more @ https://www.thelegendofheroes.com/crossbell/azure/

#TrailstoAzure
